purpose: Extend the existing Gekta P0 SPEED model-host diagnostic with bounded read-only capacity and runtime facts required to choose a safe llama.cpp G3B concurrency candidate without root access, service mutation, context loss or OOM risk.
requiredBehavior: reuse only the dedicated protected model-host SSH identity and pinned host key
run entirely as the existing least-privilege model-host SSH principal
publish only whitelisted CPU topology memory PSS service policy executable identity and llama.cpp scheduling facts
never print environment contents credentials filesystem paths raw command line prompt response model bytes or customer data
forbiddenCapabilities: production VPS credentials as fallback model-host authority
sudo su doas or any other privilege escalation
systemctl restart start stop enable disable daemon-reload or edit
file write chmod chown package install process signal or alternate model process on the model host
printing any secret environment value filesystem path or arbitrary ExecStart argument
new server paid API SaaS or recurring cost
